notes: Special abilities of animals (Abilities.cs). A species has every ability that lists its species.json group (groups), its id (species), one of its tags (tags), or whose gene (gene) it expresses at minGene or more. Abilities with unlockFunctions / unlockBehaviors (any one of them) work for a player's groups only once their species has acquired that Function or Behavior, unless the species can't acquire any of them; wild groups always have them.

abilities.name: Venom
abilities.description: Its bite or sting injects venom: a group it hits and doesn't kill is poisoned, losing a fifth of its HP each turn for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Stinging cells
abilities.description: Covered in stinging cells: its attacks poison the target for a turn, and whatever attacks it is stung back for a quarter of the damage it deals.

abilities.name: Poisonous
abilities.description: Its body is poisonous: whatever attacks it is poisoned, losing a fifth of its HP each turn for 2 turns. Its predators, used to it, eat it unharmed.

abilities.name: Electric shock
abilities.description: Stuns with an electric discharge: its attacks get through half the target's defense, and the target loses its actions next turn.

abilities.name: Sticky web
abilities.description: Catches prey in sticky silk: a group it attacks and doesn't kill is caught and loses its actions next turn.

abilities.name: Ink cloud
abilities.description: Squirts ink and slips away: it takes half damage when attacked and can't be swallowed whole.

abilities.name: Chemical spray
abilities.description: Sprays a noxious chemical at attackers: whatever attacks it loses a tenth of its HP and its actions next turn.

abilities.name: Spines
abilities.description: Bristles with spines: it can't be swallowed whole, and whatever attacks it takes back a third of the damage it deals.

abilities.name: Roll up
abilities.description: Rolls into an armoured ball: it takes 40% less damage when attacked and can't be swallowed whole.

abilities.name: Tail weapon
abilities.description: Swings a clubbed or spiked tail: its counterattacks hit twice as hard.

abilities.name: Pack hunting
abilities.description: Hunts in packs: it deals half again as much damage when another group of its side, or of its species if wild, is on or next to the target's tile.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Lies in wait: an attack made before it moves in a turn gets no counterattack.

abilities.name: Constriction
abilities.description: Coils around its prey and squeezes: a group it attacks and doesn't kill is held and loses its actions next turn.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Regrows lost parts: it heals a fifth of its HP each turn instead of a tenth.

abilities.name: Shed a limb
abilities.description: Leaves a tail, arm or leg behind: once, a blow that would wipe it out leaves it at 1 HP instead.

abilities.name: Echolocation
abilities.description: Finds its way by echoes: it sees one tile further, and camouflage doesn't hide anything from it.

abilities.name: Electroreception
abilities.description: Senses the electric fields of other animals: it sees one tile further, and neither camouflage nor a burrow hides prey from it.

abilities.name: Keen eyes
abilities.description: Spots prey from far off: it sees one tile further.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.description: Blends into its surroundings: attacks on it deal 30% less damage, unless the attacker hunts by echolocation or electric sense.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.description: Dives into its burrow when attacked: it takes half damage, unless the attacker senses it through the ground with electric sense.

abilities.name: Shell retreat
abilities.description: Pulls into its shell: it takes half damage when attacked and can't be swallowed whole, unless the attacker has a crushing bite.

abilities.name: Herd
abilities.description: Lives in herds: it takes 30% less damage when another group of its side, or of its species if wild, is next to it.

abilities.name: School
abilities.description: Swims in schools: it takes 30% less damage when another group of its side, or of its species if wild, is next to it.

abilities.name: Vigilance
abilities.description: Keeps a lookout and calls alarms: it can't be ambushed.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charges with horns, tusks or head: an attack made after moving that turn deals half again as much damage.

abilities.name: Crushing bite
abilities.description: Bites through bone and shell: rolling up and pulling into a shell don't protect against it, and spiny or shelled prey can still be swallowed.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.description: So heavy it crushes what is underfoot: its attacks also deal half damage to one more foreign group on the target tile.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.description: Runs down prey or outruns danger in bursts: one more action every turn.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: Overwhelms with sheer numbers: it can attack animals of any size bigger than itself.

abilities.name: Blood feeding
abilities.description: Drinks blood: it can feed on animals of any size bigger than itself, and heals half the damage it deals.

abilities.name: Spreads disease
abilities.description: Carries germs in its bite: a group it hits is infected, losing a tenth of its HP each turn for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Dormancy
abilities.description: Sleeps through hard times: it doesn't lose HP when it has no food (but doesn't heal either).

abilities.name: Blubber
abilities.description: Lives off a thick layer of fat: it loses only half as much HP when it has no food.

abilities.name: Prolific breeder
abilities.description: Breeds fast: it can reproduce every 2 turns instead of every 3.
